findings.text: The status calls initial views over `pragma_*` unmodeled and non-blocking, but `SELECT name FROM before.v` for `v AS SELECT name FROM pragma_table_info('t')` returns current-catalog rows while pinned SQLite rejects it. Fix: record this as a blocking correctness gap and keep the task open until the resolver enforces the supported boundary.

The current-independence restatements say “no current table,” but their `readsCurrent = false` premises also exclude every pragma source, including fixed rows. Fix: state both exclusions in the affected theorem docstrings.
`sourcesOf` uses a catch-all over results containing `Resolved.Statement`, so new constructors cannot trigger an exhaustiveness error. Fix: enumerate the remaining constructors.

The initial-view function-name collision emits guidance about supplying an initial database although one is already supplied, without identifying the conflicting current view. Fix: extend the message to describe the collision and an applicable remedy.
